book.title: Statistical Foundations of Actuarial Learning and its Applications
read_locations: Chapter6 Bayesian estimation and regularization pp207–219
book.usage_scope: Conceptual and mathematical inspiration; exact borrower feature equations are explicit adaptations, not a reproduction of a claimed credit-default model.

bernoulli_link.use: Canonical log-odds and nonlinear feature maps are representations, not additional raw information.

credibility.location: Section5.2(mixed models and credibility);Chapter6(Bayesian estimation and regularization)
credibility.use: Exposure-aware shrinkage motivates beta-binomial historical-rate features. Beta conjugacy formulas below are an explicit Bernoulli adaptation.

risk_functionals.use: Liquidity stress features are deterministic borrower cash-flow scenarios, not calibrated ruin or survival probabilities.

regularization.use: Motivates context-only selection/reduction and matched comparisons against unreduced inputs.

Consensus_status: Parent attempted selected Consensus connector; reauthentication required. Primary open-access textbook and BIS paper used as fallback.

prior_bank_limit: The previousfoldfeatures.parquet saves only~306–315 selected columns. Materialize the fullBank(specs) before top512/allbank experiments; expand skips missing inputs honestly.

alias_policy.representational_aliases: Beta logodds are monotonic transforms of existing posterior rates, not new independent information. Other a6 predictors remain deterministic functions of existing inputs.
alias_policy.algebraic_overlap: Existing stress formulas use proposed payment only; new structured scenarios include active+proposed installments. Existing net_ratio is(principal-cash)/income, distinct from current net cashflow margin.
alias_policy.automatic_dedup: Exact float32 context-value aliases and context constants are removed and logged per fold; query values do not choose what is retained.

limitations: Historical opportunity counts for different lateness thresholds do not define identical eligible sets; no severe-given-late rate is fabricated.
Recent-versus-older rates require nested windows and identical maturity definitions; invalid nesting becomes missing.
Monthly income/outflow volatility does not identify covariance or a full distribution; standardized scenarios are stress proxies, not calibrated ruin probabilities.
Loan term projections assume constant scheduled payment and income; contractual-cost feature is a nominal scenario, not a realized interest/fee or loss measure.
All current70000rows have prior development exposure; no independent statistical audit is created.
For a strict inner-stopping boundary, regenerate a6 priors and denominator floors with inner-training ctx; never fit these learned quantities on query/outer rows.
